source: City of Brentwood Municipal Code Title 17 Zoning (https://ecode360.com/43617892); Brentwood RE Zone (https://ecode360.com/43618239); R-1-E Zone (https://ecode360.com/43618280); R-1 Zone (https://ecode360.com/43618306); R-2 Zone (https://ecode360.com/43618348); General Residential Regulations (https://ecode360.com/43618096); Maps & Zoning (https://www.brentwoodca.gov/government/community-development/planning/maps-zoning)

RE.description: Ranchette Estate Zone. Semirural residential buffer between urban and agricultural areas. Single-family with limited livestock/farming. Up to 1 du/ac.

R-1-E.description: Single-Family Residential Estate Zone. Low density single-family. Base density 2 du/gross ac, max 3 du/gross ac with CUP.

R-1.description: Single-Family Residential Zone. Standard single-family. Base 3.5 du/gross ac with subzones R-1-6, R-1-8, R-1-10, R-1-12 for different lot sizes. Max 6 du/gross ac.

R-1-6.description: Single-Family Residential, 6,000 sq ft minimum lot subzone. Up to 6 du/gross ac.

R-1-8.description: Single-Family Residential, 8,000 sq ft minimum lot subzone. Up to ~5.5 du/gross ac.

R-1-10.description: Single-Family Residential, 10,000 sq ft minimum lot subzone. Up to ~4.4 du/gross ac.

R-1-12.description: Single-Family Residential, 12,000 sq ft minimum lot subzone. Up to ~3.6 du/gross ac.

R-2.description: Moderate Density Multifamily Residential Zone. Duplexes, triplexes, townhouses, small apartments. Base 9 du/gross ac, max 12 du/gross ac with CUP.

R-3.description: High Density Multifamily Residential Zone. Apartments, condominiums. Up to 20 du/gross ac.

C-1.description: Neighborhood Commercial Zone. Convenience retail and services for surrounding neighborhoods.

C-2.description: Community Commercial Zone. General retail, commercial services, and office uses.

C-3.description: Highway/Regional Commercial Zone. Large-scale and auto-oriented commercial.

M-1.description: Light Industrial Zone. Light manufacturing, assembly, warehousing.

M-2.description: Heavy Industrial Zone. General manufacturing and heavy industrial uses.

A.description: Agricultural Zone. Agricultural uses with very limited residential. Max 1 du/10 ac.
